name: Hawser
description: Hawser is the remote Docker agent for Dockhand. In Standard mode it listens on port 2376 and lets a Dockhand server manage this host's Docker; in Edge mode (DOCKHAND_SERVER_URL set) it connects out to Dockhand instead. It needs the full Docker socket, so whoever holds the token controls this host's Docker.

paths.name: Docker Socket
paths.description: Docker socket. Hawser only talks to a Unix socket; a read-only socket proxy does not work with it.

paths.name: Stacks
paths.description: Compose stack files deployed from Dockhand. If stacks use relative bind mounts, the container path must equal the host path and STACKS_DIR must be set to it.

ports.name: Agent Port
ports.description: Standard mode API (HTTP, or HTTPS with TLS_CERT/TLS_KEY). Not needed in Edge mode.

variables.name: Token
variables.description: Shared token Dockhand sends in the X-Hawser-Token header. Required unless the agent binds a loopback address only; Hawser refuses to start without it otherwise.

variables.name: Agent Name
variables.description: Optional: name shown in Dockhand. Defaults to the container hostname.

variables.name: Dockhand Server URL
variables.description: Optional: wss://<dockhand>/api/hawser/connect switches to Edge mode. Leave empty for Standard mode.
